python3 -c "
def rel_lum(r,g,b):
    def f(c):
        c/=255
        return c/12.92 if c<=0.03928 else ((c+0.055)/1.055)**2.4
    r,g,b=f(r),f(g),f(b)
    return 0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*b

def contrast(c1,c2):
    l1,l2=rel_lum(*c1),rel_lum(*c2)
    l1,l2=max(l1,l2),min(l1,l2)
    return (l1+0.05)/(l2+0.05)

ink=(20,41,61)
white=(255,255,255)
paper=(245,246,244)
ochre=(192,138,46)
print('ink on white', contrast(ink,white))
print('white on ink (header text)', contrast(white,ink))
print('ochre badge text white-on-ochre', contrast(white,ochre))
"
